name: Brown Sugar-Cinnamon Butter
desc: Whipped butter with dark brown sugar and cinnamon for toast, biscuits, or cornbread.

source.title: Brown Sugar-Cinnamon Butter
source.evidence: Same three ingredients in the same amounts (1/2 cup butter, 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, 1/4 tsp cinnamon) and the same beat-with-a-mixer instruction, nearly word for word.

steps: Let the butter sit at room temperature until it dents easily when pressed.
Beat the butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon in a bowl with an electric mixer on high until creamy and smooth, about 1 minute.
Transfer to a small dish or jar, cover, and keep refrigerated. Let it stand at room temperature 15 minutes before spreading.
tips: Allrecipes does not say salted or unsalted. Unsalted works too; add a pinch of fine salt.

references.title: Brown Sugar-Cinnamon Butter
references.usedFor: mixer speed and time, refrigerate between uses, yield
